sol_unit_mk1.name: Sol Unit Mk1
sol_unit_mk1.description: Standard-issue Lightkeeper sol unit. A reliable 5x5 grid with balanced energy capacity. Nothing fancy, but it keeps the lights on.

sol_unit_mk1_plus.name: Sol Unit Mk1+
sol_unit_mk1_plus.description: Military-grade Sol Unit frame with a 6x6 component grid. Recovered from a Lightkeeper squad's supply cache. More grid space and charge than the standard Mk1.

nightcaster_frame.name: Nightcaster Frame
nightcaster_frame.description: A sol unit modified by Unbounded engineers for deep-dark raids. Compact grid and reduced energy reserves, but its dark-tuned emitters amplify all damage output. Insulated circuitry provides cold resistance. Favored by Lightkeepers who hit hard and move fast.

array_precision_core.name: Array Precision Core
array_precision_core.description: Manufactured by the Array to exacting tolerances. Its energy management systems are unmatched — every ability draws less power, and the deep charge reservoir keeps you in the field longer. Thermal shielding rated for dayside conditions. What MERIDIAN-7 builds, MERIDIAN-7 builds well.

greenway_bioframe.name: Greenway Bioframe
greenway_bioframe.description: A sol unit integrated with Ring bio-tech — living tissue woven through its circuitry. Symbiotic organisms siphon energy from combat impacts and convert it to healing. Bio-filters neutralize airborne toxins. The largest standard grid available, enabling complex component arrangements.

underlumen_nexus.name: Underlumen Nexus
underlumen_nexus.description: Recovered from the deepest pre-human ruins in the Nightside. Its crystalline substrate resonates with the planetary network, cycling abilities faster than any human-built frame. The 8x8 grid opens build possibilities no other unit can match.
